devon: FYI — Acme reported a big month-end mismatch. Invoice shows 18,210,342 tokens but dashboard sums to 17,193,001. Invoice_id inv_8421.
sara_support: ouch. which line is the delta on?
devon: the 'generation' line primarily. customer says it spiked only at end of day on 2024-08-31.
leo_eng: i ran the invoice query against raw_events and got 18,210,342 too. dashboard pipeline query gives 17,193,001.
sara_support: can you paste the queries you ran?
leo_eng: sure:
```sql
-- invoice generator
SELECT SUM(tokens) as total
FROM raw_events
WHERE account_id = 'acme'
  AND billed_at >= '2024-08-01'
  AND billed_at < '2024-09-01';
```
returns 18210342

```sql
-- dashboard aggregate (quick)
SELECT SUM(tokens) as total
FROM token_aggregates
WHERE account_id = 'acme'
  AND window_start >= '2024-08-01'
  AND window_start < '2024-09-01';
```
returns 17193001

sara_support: noted. any clue on field differences? billed_at vs window_start?
leo_eng: yes — invoice uses billed_at (set by the rollup job) which is in server local time (legacy UTC-7). dashboard uses window_start stored normalized to UTC. there's a chance events near midnight got assigned twice by two rollup runs.
tara_ops: @sanjay_billing can you check the rollup job logs around midnight 2024-09-01? looking for duplicate runs or missed locks.
sanjay_billing: checked CI logs: rollup-v2 ran at 2024-09-01T00:30:12Z (success) and again at 2024-09-01T01:05:03Z (success). second run didn't detect the distributed lock due to a transient zk timeout.
devon: that timing fits. i suspect events in 2024-08-31T23:50:00Z..2024-09-01T00:10:00Z were ingested twice into billed_at bucket.
leo_eng: quick repro query:
```sql
SELECT event_id, tokens, ts, billed_at
FROM raw_events
WHERE account_id = 'acme'
  AND ts >= '2024-08-31T23:50:00Z'
  AND ts <= '2024-09-01T00:10:00Z'
ORDER BY ts;
```
this returned ~1,017,341 tokens worth of events, with duplicates for ~4% of event_ids (same event_id present twice with different billed_at).
sara_support: customer expects either corrected invoice or credit. what's ETA to fix?
tara_ops: remediation steps I propose:
1) identify duplicate event_ids and remove duplicates from billed table for inv_8421 window (script + dry-run)
2) regenerate invoice and run QA
3) if regen delay > 24h propose provisional credit to customer and mark invoice under investigation

devon: i've opened INC-2419 and assigned to billing oncall. i'll DM ACME offering a provisional credit and ETA ~8 hours.
leo_eng: will attach a safe idempotent rollback script to the incident. snippet:
```bash
python scripts/remove_billed_duplicates.py --account acme --window "2024-08-01" "2024-09-01" --dry-run
```

sanjay_billing: ran the dry-run, found 9,412 duplicate event_ids amounting to 1,017,341 tokens. ready to run with lock in maintenance window.
billing-bot: Invoice inv_8421 status updated -> under_investigation (tag: billing-audit).
sara_support: thanks all. I'll update the customer thread with a note and credit offer. :thumbsup:
leo_eng: :eyes: will follow up with postmortem and change to lock handling to avoid zk timeout causing duplicate rollups.
devon: keeping thread open until invoice regen complete.
_: generated for month-end dashboard vs invoice mismatch investigation
